rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

corrected_mechanism_support.artillery_candidate_timeline: Cast starts cooldown and selection; with no slowdown, OnAttack creates the fixed-point projectile about cast+0.333333 seconds, and the hit is about creation+3.0 seconds. This is 2.7.81 candidate evidence, not build-2771 equality.
corrected_mechanism_support.disappear_appear: enemy is hidden between source DISAPPEAR and APPEAR_AT_POS; exact client visibility and target rules remain UNKNOWN
corrected_mechanism_support.fragment_or_wave_wait: checkpoint time is used as the wait duration in the current model
corrected_mechanism_support.medical_candidate_scope: The confirmed ratio filter selects the lowest missing-HP-ratio in range and excludes full HP; exact equal-ratio tie-break remains UNKNOWN.
corrected_mechanism_support.neutral_faction_and_ordinary_blocking: Ursus Civilian is neutral; ordinary operators neither attack nor block it
corrected_mechanism_support.officer_protected_target_attack_radius: enemy_1107_uoffcr can normally attack Ursus Civilian within 1.2
corrected_mechanism_support.protected_target_candidate_scope: Neutral-promotion before hatred sorting is confirmed for the 2.7.81 selector; exact hatred values and all tie-breaks remain UNKNOWN.
corrected_mechanism_support.protected_target_life_scoring: safe arrival neither leaks nor deducts life; death deducts 1 and is not a kill
corrected_mechanism_support.roadblock_special_blocking: PRTS-backed 0.4472 roadblock radius blocks Ursus Civilian and release occurs on destruction; it is not ordinary operator blocking
corrected_mechanism_support.stage_move_multiplier: applied once to enemy raw move speed
unknowns: other protected-target families and exact continuous-frame client timing
corrected_mechanism_support.win_rule: remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies

decision_task.forbidden: No automatic controller, no mechanism rewrite, no unverified instant retargeting or free redeployment.
decision_task.must_cover: all routes from first spawn to final WIN condition, continuous protected passage, artillery and #34 closure
decision_task.objective: find a complete fixed-simulator WIN with at most 7 distinct deployed operator IDs; if a smaller union wins, it is still valid
priorities: reduce harmful contact duration through earlier effective output
allow valid retreat/sacrifice handoffs only with real coverage
rebalance blocking and mixed damage; do not target low aggregate contribution alone

m58_execution_capability_contract.ansel_talent: The probabilistic extra-heal talent is unsupported; do not assume double healing.
m58_execution_capability_contract.artillery_ability: Ability cast starts target selection and cooldown; projectile birth locks the impact point and has its own delayed splash flow.
m58_execution_capability_contract.ordinary_attack: Current model selects the target at ATTACK_STRIKE; it has no reliable pre-swing target lock. A completed attack's cooldown is not reset by changing target.
m58_execution_capability_contract.spot_skill: EXECUTABLE_APPROXIMATED: initial SP25/SP40, 25 seconds, ATK+45%, 1.3-second healing interval, x-4 nine-cell range, and healing stops attacks; the physical-dodge talent is unsupported.
m58_execution_capability_contract.usage: These are current executor limits, not arguments against user experience. Separate current-model-checkable baiting from USER_PREMISE_NOT_EXPRESSIBLE pre-swing timing.

milestone_constraints.counting_rule: The union of selected_low_star_operator_ids and every DEPLOY action operator_id is counted; retreat and redeploy do not reduce distinct-operator count.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Execute only the supported fixed-projectile withdrawal. Eastern Steward kills artillery; both physicians sustain exposed recipients and Spot supplements the second lower barrage. Source death does not remove existing projectiles.
Midnight destroys eastern restraint3 while holding upper-outer hostiles. Artillery must die before a dangerous western return. Final western clearance must permit civilian3 to arrive safely.
Opening Melantha destroys eastern restraint4. Spot intercepts later lower-outer officers. Final western Melantha destroys restraint2 after hostile clearance and permits civilian14 to arrive safely.

Fang blocks upper-central traffic. Melantha kills armor21, clears runners without her reserved skill, then uses that skill against armor33. Returning Steward is deliberately excluded from this holder.

Friston contains lower-central traffic. Midnight contributes whenever his own queue permits. Returning Steward clears armor22 and34; a slot must open for actual BLOCK on34 before it passes the holder.
Midnight remains upper-outer interceptor. His own blocked enemies take precedence over central assistance. Ansel's delayed active extension must preserve him through the final officer.

Melantha handles the opening; Spot holds all subsequent officers. Avoid attack stoppage before the final officer is captured. Returning Steward may assist when no higher-defense lower-central target competes.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central two-block interception, adjacent lower-central attacks and automatic income.
Lower-central three-block containment; survival depends on timely clearance and effective medical targeting.
Upper-outer interception, eastern restraint3 clearance and available central assistance.
Opening lower-outer interception, restraint4 destruction and one fixed-projectile withdrawal.
Central and eastern medicine; active extension also reaches Midnight.
Second medical stream covering both central holders, Ansel and both Steward combat positions.
Persistent lower-outer successor and local healing support.
Second deployment: direct damage to enemies held by Fang, with attack skill reserved for final upper armor.
Second deployment: lower-exclusive central arts coverage and lower-outer assistance.

formation_structure.decisive_change: Returning Steward [5,5]RIGHT covers [4,5], [4,6] and [6,5], but excludes Fang [3,5]. His high-defense priority therefore cannot divert him to upper armor33. Melantha owns that upper armor instead.

economy.dependency: Fang income requires living deployment. Each refund requires living withdrawal. Missing credits indicate failed survival or handoff dependencies; death refunds zero.

medical_budget.basis: Two runners: 2*(380-235)/1.5; one armored ranged enemy: 340/2.8.
medical_budget.limitation: These are capacity calculations, not guaranteed delivery. Healing competition, strike alignment and damage on Fang or the physicians can defeat the handoff.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Both physicians cover Fang [3,5], Friston [4,5] and returning Steward [5,5]. Melantha [3,4] is outside their ordinary coverage and must avoid direct interception. Spot's active nine-cell range covers Ansel and returning Steward, but not Friston.
formation_structure.opening: Fang, Friston, Midnight and Melantha establish four interceptions. Both physicians precede sustained eastern artillery exposure. Spot succeeds Melantha after the opening shell has resolved.

opening_projectile_handoff.beneficiary: Steward enters outside the old impact radius; Spot occupies the vacated interception tile only after impact.
opening_projectile_handoff.cooldown_accounting: The actual cast consumes its normal cooldown. Retreat does not reset it or erase the projectile.
opening_projectile_handoff.decoy_survival_requirement: Melantha must survive through projectile birth and living withdrawal, with her held enemies already cleared.
opening_projectile_handoff.known_behavior: Cast starts cooldown; projectile birth fixes the impact point. Born projectiles persist after retreat.
opening_projectile_handoff.residual_risk: An unobserved cast target, uncleared runner/officer, surviving shell or civilian entering acquisition range invalidates this transfer.

formation_structure.upper_runner_budget: Against a runner with100 DEF, unboosted Melantha contributes638/1.5 and Fang225/1.05 damage per second when both actually attack it. The ideal combined clearance is about5.48 seconds, below the seven-second paired spawn interval. Contact and targeting must be observed; this supports reserving Melantha's skill rather than proving runner clearance.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only range, capped DP ledger, declared SP intervals and redeployment gaps checked. No stage simulation was run. Full-stage feasibility remains unverified.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw living Melantha after the assigned projectile is born; the lower-outer queue and restraint4 must already be cleared.
Deploy eastern Steward outside the locked former Melantha impact.
Spot inherits the lower-outer tile after the residual impact.
Spot temporarily replaces attacks with local healing through the second lower artillery exposure.
Return Melantha beside Fang for upper armor and runner damage.
Withdraw Steward after actual artillery death and resolution of its residual projectiles. This advances his central return by40 frames.
Begin the delayed third Ansel skill, covering late outer interception and the coming lower queue.
Begin the delayed third Hibiscus skill; both medical boosts now overlap through6650.
Activate Melantha's reserved attack skill for final upper armor, rather than spending it on the earlier runner window.
Return Steward at [5,5]RIGHT to clear lower armor without upper armor target competition.
Spot heals locally only after the final lower-outer officer is actually captured.
After hostile central clearance, withdraw Steward; withdraw Melantha at8101.
Return Steward west; return Melantha at10202 to finish both western restraints and observe protected-target arrivals.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions and both physicians, preserve Fang income, clear Melantha's queue and restraint4, and survive through projectile birth.
Finish the projectile handoff, sustain eastern Steward through artillery clearance, use Spot for the second lower barrage and preserve Midnight's interception.
Melantha removes armor21 and then upper runners without spending her reserved attack skill. Friston holds armor22; maintain medical recovery while the third boosts remain reserved.

Deliver overlapping medical boosts, activate Melantha for upper armor33, and return lower-exclusive Steward. Clear armor22 or another occupant before34 needs a block slot. Verify healing recipients and actual BLOCK events.
Finish lower armor and runners before containment fails, finish upper armor through Melantha, and preserve Spot's final officer containment. Later medical activations support remaining recovery.
Finish remaining outer hostiles, complete western restraint clearance and observe both distinct safe arrivals. Do not infer acceptance from a quiet screen or positive life alone.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income only while living and deployed; no manual action.
Ordinary three-block containment; no unsupported robot talent.
Eastern restraint clearance, then available central arts assistance. Own blocked officers can interrupt that assistance.
Preserve early artillery recovery; delay the third activation until it covers late interception and the former fatal queue. No probabilistic extra heal.
Preserve supported early recovery, then place the third boost over lower mixed pressure instead of exhausting it before that pressure.
Local healing during the second lower barrage and after the last outer officer is captured. Healing stops attacks; dodge is not credited.
Reserve the first skill of the second deployment for final upper armor. Earlier armor21 and runners use ordinary attacks.
Supported automatic enhanced hits and high-defense priority. First deployment closes artillery; second excludes upper armor by range.

previous_plan_to_revise.tactical_thesis: Preserve the supported four-lane opening, then separate final armor duties by geometry. Melantha retains upper-central clearance and reserves her attack skill for armor33. Returning Steward faces RIGHT from [5,5], covering the lower holder and its approach while excluding the upper holder. Delay the third medical activations so both boosts overlap the former fatal lower queue. This is an unsimulated, CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE candidate; healing allocation, lower armor clearance and actual interception remain falsifiable.

user_confirmed_tactical_premise: Enemy attacks have intervals; many attacks point at one object and occupy the attacker during the action. Operators may bait attacks, absorb key hits, buy replacement/output windows, and may deliberately withdraw or sacrifice for these effects. This is USER_CONFIRMED_TACTICAL_PREMISE, not new client evidence. Do not generalize it to all attacks, phases, targets, cooldowns, retreats, landing tiles, or cycles; every tactic must identify the known or assumed behavior it uses.
